name: S8
description: The Audi S8 (1994–present) is the performance flagship saloon. The D2 pioneered the aluminium Space Frame in series production (1994); the D5 uses a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 with 48V mild-hybrid and active suspension. Each generation represents the apex of Audi's technology.
